name: The Dark Iron War
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
War rages both home and abroad.  While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves.  They laid waste to the Thandol Span.  Dun Modr fell soon after.

We need you to gather force and push the front back.  If you can kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

Now make haste!
narrative.objectives: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves,  5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
narrative.offerRewardText: You upheld your orders well, Champion. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .
narrative.requestItemsText: Roggo has been unable to contact the reserve forces. We need offensive pressure on that Dark Iron encampment, champion. Now get back out there and serve your duty to King Magni!
